classifier.comment: TEMPORARY stub. mode 'uniform': correct with probability Pc, errors spread equally over the other classes (PLACEHOLDER shape). mode 'confusion': row-normalised matrix of a json file (confusion_file). mode 'confusion_counts': event-level COUNTS in confusion_counts_file (csv: first column = true class, then one column per predicted class); every call of classify_batch (one simulated day) draws each row from Dirichlet(counts + prior), so the error rates carry the uncertainty of the few events behind them. Change only this file to switch; no code edit.
classifier.Pc_source: Pc_DAS of the parameter table, low end of 0.983 to 0.993 (wang2024); 0.993 is the high-end sensitivity
classifier.sensitivity_note: The Brno confusion matrix (results/classifier/T1s/confusion_matrix.csv) is a SENSITIVITY only, labelled 'Brno, 4 test recordings, SENSITIVITY'; the base stays mode 'uniform' (Pc from the literature). In mode 'confusion_counts' every class missing from the matrix (running, digging, tampering, background, animal) falls back to the uniform stub.

reid.comment: Re-identification (DAS track <-> camera / drone track). Design: docs/ReID_Design_and_Evaluation_Protocol.pdf. Error values are the planning values of the protocol (ASSUMED); the same values are rows reid_* of config/parameters_reviewed.tsv (tests/test_reid.py checks they agree). Thresholds gate_sigma and margin are re-chosen on development scenes by reid/evaluate.py (results/reid/thresholds.json) and then frozen.

pos_sd_cam_drone_m.source: optimistic and base: PROXY from Nalamothu et al. 2024 (arXiv 2410.12556), per-axis sigma = mean radial error / 1.25; static target, GPS type not stated, so optimistic. pessimistic 5 m: ASSUMED (source pending)
